If it was a stroke, he'd be in the same situation from your point of view. Electrocution seems unlikely but regardless, the only thing you can do is try to contact his local EMS system or family.

Personally, I think this sounds like a seizure, but that's good because unless the seizure was very, very severe, it's very easy to recover from without EMS intervention. Either way, he needs to see a doctor if he lost consciousness without explanation. Hope he's okay.
